[INFERENCE] This mountainous region of western Serbia, characterized by forested hills and valleys, would typically have fewer small airports than flat agricultural areas. [ESTIMATE] Based on regional knowledge, the nearest small airports would likely be general aviation facilities serving nearby towns, but I cannot reliably estimate distances without specific airport location data. [UNKNOWN] No enrichment data was provided for airport proximity, and I lack sufficient knowledge of specific small airfield locations in the Zlatibor region to determine whether any exist within the 10 km threshold. The mountainous terrain makes agricultural airstrips less likely, but recreational flying facilities or small municipal airstrips could exist. Without access to Serbian CAA registers or detailed local knowledge, the assessment remains inconclusive.
